subject: Rate uplift for product launch?
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@launchio.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Rate uplift for product launch?

Hi Priya / Ben,

Quick note — we have a major feature debuting on Aug 20 and expect a concentrated traffic spike during the first 48–72 hours. Our forecasts look like a ~4x burst vs our committed tier. Can Redwood temporarily raise our rate limits / headroom for the window and provide any courtesy credit for the expected overrun?

We'd like to avoid production degradation; if we need to pay an uplift that's fine as long as it's predictable and we can reconcile with procurement quickly. Attaching the initial traffic snapshot.

Can we get an indicative path today? Procurement is Sarah's team (procurement@launchio.com) if you need a PO.

Thanks,
Sarah Patel
Head of Growth, LaunchIO

Attachment: launch_snapshot_aug15.csv (attachment stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@launchio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Rate uplift for product launch?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can support a short-term uplift but need a couple quick inputs to size it and finalize commercial terms:

- Forecasted peak QPS and estimated total tokens over the 72h window (can use the attached template).
- Does LaunchIO expect the burst to be uniformly distributed or concentrated into a 4–6 hour launch window?
- Procurement contact + PO timing (you mentioned procurement@launchio.com).

Prelim options we can enable today:
- Fast-path: temporary headroom (3x your committed QPS) enabled for a defined window; billing at normal committed rate up to committed tier, then overrun billed at our overrun rate with a promotional credit applied.
- Alternative: reserved short-term Dedicated pool (if you want guaranteed latency) — needs a 48–72 hour lead to provision.

I'm attaching a small forecast template (LaunchIO_traffic_forecast_template.xlsx) — if you return that by EOD we can get a formal proposal within 24 hours. If helpful I can loop in Dev Patel to validate the runtime limits.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: LaunchIO_traffic_forecast_template.xlsx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T12:25:00Z
Subject: FWD: Rate uplift for product launch?  (internal)

Ben / Dev — internal quick thread to align before I send the formal offer. Key facts from Sarah: likely 72h spike, up to ~4x committed. Options: enable 72h headroom (soft, auto-fallback), or provision a short-lived Dedicated pool.

My commercial thoughts:
- Offer a provisional overrun credit: 40% credit on overrun charges up to $15k, provided they sign the amendment (standard PO or emailed approval) by EOD Aug 18.
- Enable 3x headroom for Aug 20 00:00 UTC — Aug 22 23:59 UTC. Activation is a flip, no infra install if soft headroom.
- If they want guaranteed latency, propose expedited Dedicated for a 48h lead (we'd need capacity sign-off).

Dev — can you confirm we can safely enable 3x for that window without impacting other tenants? Also any risk to KV cache warmup we should warn them about?

Ben — finance side: would we be comfortable with a $15k capped credit? If not, propose a $10k cap.

Thanks — I'll incorporate your inputs and send to Sarah.

— Priya

(Internal notes appended)
Dev Patel replied: We can do soft headroom 3x for 72h; recommend adding a pre-warm window of 2 hours to reduce tail latency. No infra changes required.
Ben Carter replied: Finance can approve a $12k capped promotional credit for one-off launch support; need deal id on the amendment.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@launchio.com>, LaunchIO Sales <launchio-sales@launchio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Rate uplift for product launch?

Sarah — thanks for the quick follow. Based on the forecast you returned, here's a concise proposal we can activate if you confirm by Aug 18 EOD: 

Proposal (activation window: 2027-08-20 00:00 UTC — 2027-08-22 23:59 UTC):
- Temporary headroom: increase rate limits to 3x committed QPS for the 72-hour window (soft headroom; auto-fallback at end of window).
- Billing: committed-tier pricing applies up to committed throughput. Any consumption above committed tier during the window will be billed at Redwood's overrun rate of $0.10 / 1k tokens.
- Promotional concession: Redwood will apply a one-time 40% credit to overrun charges for that window, capped at $12,000, provided a signed amendment or emailed approval (PO) is received by 2027-08-18 23:59 UTC.
- SLA safeguard: if p50 latency exceeds 600ms for >30 minutes during the window, Redwood will apply an additional $1,000 credit.

Attachments and next steps:
- Attached: 2027-08-15-LaunchIO-temporary-uplift-amendment.pdf (amendment + acceptance language).
- DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/abc123 — please sign or reply with approval.
- If procurement cannot deliver a PO by Aug 18 EOD, we can accept an emailed approval up to $5,000 by the same deadline; amounts above $5,000 require a formal PO.

Technical notes: per Dev Patel, we recommend a 2-hour warm window starting at 22:00 UTC on Aug 19 to pre-warm caches and KV shards. We'll coordinate a staging traffic test prior to activation if you want.

If that looks good I can send a finalized amendment and loop legal for a very short sign-off.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2027-08-15-LaunchIO-temporary-uplift-amendment.pdf

From: Sarah Patel <sarah@launchio.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@launchio.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Rate uplift for product launch?

Thanks Priya — appreciate the fast turnaround. We agree in principle to the 3x headroom and the 40% overrun credit with the $12k cap. Two asks before we sign: 

1) Procurement prefers to issue a formal PO but they won't be able to do it before Monday; will Redwood accept an email approval for up to $5k now and the PO to follow for the remainder? (I saw that in your note and that works for us unless you object.)
2) Can you add a short ramp-down clause to the amendment so we don't immediately drop to full throttle right after the window — a 12-hour taper would be ideal.

If you can add the ramp-down clause and accept the email approval for $5k, we'll approve and procurement will route the PO first thing Monday morning.

Thanks — Sarah
Head of Growth, LaunchIO
procurement@launchio.com (procurement cc)
